scorecard.rationale: An acute paper-filtered coffee crossover in healthy habitual users found less mental fatigue than flavored water. A six-person fortified-decaf crossover found less post-nap fatigue. The paired driving studies shared young participants and reported inconclusive fatigue changes. Abrupt decaf replacement in seven members of a nine-person residential series produced higher fatigue and showed a plausible withdrawal pathway. The newly traced nine-person isolated-caffeine crossover also followed abstinence and found lower tiredness. A separate trial measured sleep latency and vigilance, with no standalone fatigue result in the author abstract. The short Parkinson caffeine trial favored lower FSS with an interval spanning both directions. The brewed-coffee effect therefore remains a minimal easing lean with unresolved transfer to Parkinson fatigue.
